claim: Highlighting tokens by lowest generation probability gave no benefit over no highlighting, whereas highlighting by predicted edit likelihood sped task completion and focused edits.
stance_target: L4 occupancy: localization of likely-wrong code regions
scope_conditions: Abstract; Sec. 6 results; closed-world edit model on 3 tasks
quoted_support: In contrast, highlighting tokens according to their probability of being generated does not provide any benefit over the baseline with no highlighting.

breadth.confidence_families: Codex token generation probability; learned edit-likelihood model (Sec. 4-5)
breadth.benchmarks: three LeetCode-derived tasks plus two pilots (Sec. 5)
breadth.label_source: programmer edits and unit tests passed (Sec. 3)
breadth.calibration_metrics: not present (user-study metrics: time, tests passed, edits)
breadth.causal_intervention: randomized between-condition user study (N=30); no model intervention
